text:
Priya K: Quick sync — we need to pick a CTA for the per-route insight card in Console. Two proposals: (A) 'Preview samples' that opens a sampling preview (no savedview), (B) 'Save & Apply' which creates a saved query and wires routing/quota hints. Which direction? :thinking:
Marco G: +1 for Preview. Lower friction, ops can sanity-check without committing savedviews.
Alex R: Product prefers 'Save & Apply' because savedviews = better discoverability + triggers analytics. But I get friction.
Lina S: Ops caution: savedviews run quota checks immediately. If we auto-save we need to surface expected token burn and any routing impact before committing.
Jeremy C: Could we show a tiny estimate line on the preview modal? Like 'Est. tokens: 120 — est. cost $0.012' and a sample-rate slider. That keeps preview safe but educates.
Priya K: Prototype payload for preview API: `{"sample_rate": 0.05, "max_rows": 100, "estimate_tokens": 120}` — backend could return estimate with that.
Marco G: Backend can return an estimate if we pass sample_rate. API route: `POST /api/console/insights/preview` — avoid running full telemetry collection, return quick approx using counters.
Zoe B: UX note: show different CTAs based on permission: if user can create savedviews -> show 'Save as view' + small dropdown (preview, save); otherwise show just 'Preview samples'. Simpler and less surprising.
Lina S: Also want an inline warning if estimate > 500k tokens: 'This preview may incur quota checks and notifications.'
Alex R: Metric ask: if we bias toward Preview, will we lose product signals (saves as signal)? Maybe add an opt-in analytics ping when preview is used to record intent.
Jeremy C: Implementation detail: a lightweight 'intent' event is fine (`preview_used`, `preview_sample_rate`) — low sample rate for telemetry to avoid noise.
ops-bot: heads-up: last week a savedview caused a quota-alert for team-eng when token estimate > 1M. See #incidents/2025-02-12.
Priya K: Action items: Marco -> add estimate field to preview API (ETA tomorrow). Lina -> mock modal with cost line + big warning state for >500k. Alex -> check analytics requirement (signal vs save). Jeremy -> specify telemetry event shape. Zoe -> UX copy variants for permission states. Revisit in standup. :thumbsup:
